title: Free Space Path Loss
text: Apply free space path loss to complex signal, 1 input, 1 output; {Mode} sets the loss calculation mode, {Loss (dB)} sets the power loss, {Distance (km)} sets the distance between transmitter and receiver and {Carrier frequency (MHz)}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Mode
params.values: Loss calculation mode Decibels (default) | Distance and Frequency

params.name: Distance (km)
params.values: Distance between transmitter and receiver 0.100 (default) | scalar
